reviews.reason: Existing insulation can dry outside rain, and fire can provide heat, but neither supplies rain interception for a saturated mantle. The insulating shelter does not declare rain exclusion. Develop a small, finite-life rain canopy with actual covered drying. Your wet mantle still reduces cooling, but drying will not immediately restore body temperature. Construction requires real collected materials; this review supplies neither materials nor protection. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Separate physical relief, transient pleasure and sustained satisfaction. Construction and drying alone award nothing: drying fabric is not necessarily felt relief, especially while the actor remains cold. Declare rain-canopy-exposure-measured and rain-canopy-comfort-qualified. For the living wearer only, three consecutive stationary rest/wait rounds under actual coverage qualify when health does not decline, satiety is at least 20, and the real mantle's moisture reduction produces strictly less cooling and cold discomfort than a same-round counterfactual retaining its pre-drying moisture. Completion emits qualified=true with participant, measured temperatures, moisture, avoided cooling and eligibleRounds. Subscribe this event as an alternative trigger to existing thermal-refuge: transient amount 1, shared cap 1, duration 6 rounds, shared cooldown 12; repeated genuine relief is eligible without novelty. Route continued qualifying participation through that source's shared maintenance mechanism at 0.025 per eligible round, decaying 0.003 per nonqualifying round, with transient and sustained components combined by maximum and capped at 1. Never accrue twice from canopy, mantle, shelter, exercise or fire in the same round. No application, learning, ownership or completion reward; health and nutrition remain independent.
reviews.visualReview: Declare rain-canopy-work-started, rain-canopy-work-progress, rain-canopy-work-completed, rain-canopy-work-cancelled and rain-canopy-cover-expired, alongside the exposure and comfort events. Render the paid construction stage, four real posts, overhead bark panels and deteriorating gaps; expose condition, footprint and current rain transmission on inspection. Show intercepted rain only inside actual covered geometry, while leaving ambient rain visible outside. Exposure events report canopy and mantle identities, effective rain, moisture before/after and measured insulation effects. Replay reconstructs structure creation, exact work progress, cancellation releases, covering wear and drying from authoritative state/events, not cosmetic shelter labels. Do not display warmth or wellbeing gains unless those effects actually occurred.
reviews.specification:
Implement rain-canopy@1 through the current versioned handoff. Public interface rain-canopy-work has a strict schema: mode='build', x:number, y:number, angle:number, materials:[{target:string,quantity:number in positive exact tenths}]; reject other fields. Shared references use item:ID/object:ID/resource:ID and existing compatibility aliases; resolve materials to exact owned, unreserved stacks, report ambiguity, and retain identities throughout execution. Requires no learned prerequisite; usable binding and bark-panel substitutions follow existing material compatibility. Build consumes 4 branch, 6 bark-compatible panels and 2 vine-compatible bindings over 6 consecutive stationary rounds at 1.5 energy per round, with ordinary metabolism. This is an executable precursor to more elaborate waterproof clothing or heated drying, not a promise of either.
State/geometry: create a persistent 2x2 roof centered at x,y and rotated by angle, supported by four solid radius-0.08 corner posts. Its overhead footprint is nonblocking to walking, is not a room, and supplies no insulation, wind reduction, rest bonus or heat. Require the footprint and post clearance to avoid water, existing solids, roofs and actors other than the builder; stand within 0.65 of the front edge, with unobstructed reach. Use the shared continuous collision and exposure geometry, including actor radius; protection applies only when the actor's whole horizontal footprint lies beneath the roof. Posts remain obstacles after covering expires. Store exact input provenance, total mass, moisture, roof condition initially 120, geometry and creation identity. Condition loses 0.5 times ambient rain each round. Roof rain transmission is 0.1+0.9*(1-condition/120), clamped to [0.1,1]; condition zero gives no interception. Do not count roof overlap repeatedly or multiply duplicate covers.
Moisture mechanism: bind mantle processing to the actual local transmitted rain. Beneath a functioning canopy, when transmitted rain is <=0.15, mantle moisture decreases by 0.02 per round to a floor of zero; otherwise it increases by 0.10 times transmitted rain, capped at one. Apply this to equipped mantles on covered actors and unequipped mantle instances physically beneath the canopy, including ground items; carried items use carrier position. Outside this new coverage retain existing mantle wetting/drying behavior. Process moisture once per tick before the existing insulation calculation, leaving its condition wear and cooling formula intact. The roof itself cannot heat the mantle or actor, heal, preserve food or prevent starvation. Drying can improve the existing moisture-dependent cooling reduction gradually; continued cold injury remains possible.
Execution: reserve actual materials once in actor-owned escrow; record six remaining paid work units, decrementing only after a valid paid round. Revalidate life, energy, position, reach and geometry each round and atomically before completion. Completion consumes escrow into exactly one structure. Movement, incompatible action, death or invalidation cancels, releases surviving unconsumed escrow exactly once at its lawful carrier/death location, and never refunds effort or duplicates materials. Global pauses preserve identities and exact remaining work without advancing simulation time. Cancelled work creates no roof. Structural and covering mass remains accounted for in the persistent structure, including after expiration; no automatic salvage or replacement stock.
Dependencies/migration: reuse inventory reservation, compatible willow materials, shared geometry, weather exposure, mantle processing and the existing thermal-refuge source. Install nullable canopy exposure metadata and new versioned structure state without changing old items, existing shelter effects, historical events, source balances or mastery. Existing objects do not become rainproof retroactively. Implementation, personal learning and actual construction are separate.
